heard: Defenders taunted Alexander that he needed winged soldiers to take their mountain. Though the timeline is muddled, in 327 BC he reached this Sogdian fortress. He offered 12 talents to 300 volunteers. They drove iron tent pegs into ice all night. Thirty men fell and vanished in the snow. At dawn, survivors signaled from the summit that the impossible climb was over. The fortress surrendered to soldiers who did not need wings.
